title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE EMPLOYMENT OF AN ADDITIONAL CLERK AND CONSTABLE IN THE OFFICE OF THE JUSTICE OF THE PEACE AT CEBU.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE EMPLOYMENT OF AN ADDITIONAL CLERK AND CONSTABLE IN THE OFFICE OF THE JUSTICE OF THE PEACE AT CEBU.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00035_1900_html.txt

text.en:
Authority is hereby given for the employment of an additional clerk at a salary of six dollars per
month and of a constable at a salary of four dollars per month, in money of the United States, in the court of
the justice of the peace at Cebu.

This Act will take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 27, 1900.
